<thought>Using the high‑intensity peak at m/z 262.099 (ESI‑positive) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is 262.099 – 1.007276 ≈ 261.092 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed ~20 % M+1 isotopic intensity (≈ 18 carbons) is C₁₈H₁₃O₂, whose calculated neutral mass is 261.0916 Da and whose [M+H]⁺ mass is 262.0988 Da, within a few ppm of the measured value.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
